target.definition: Host evaluateWin on actual opponent concealed hand plus offered tile, exposed melds, missing suit and fan cap3, with empty situational context. Zero means no legal HU. This labels potential base payment if legal HU accepted, not actual choice/payment or future net.

validation.split: 5 folds grouped by original seed, 32 train / 8 held out in each; all pre-fixed in plan
validation.reasonForNoCI: Training folds overlap; rows, seats, lineups and counterfactual candidate labels are correlated, not independent samples.
validation.scope: Metrics/seed partitions/iterations/calibration saved; original bound source+dataset support rerun. No independent reconstruction of every OOF probability was performed.

limitations: Forecast task only: no new gameplay or win-rate/net-score improvement proof, no reinforcement learning, no human expert labels.
All original seeds are old development data; final exported model fits all forty. They cannot be reused as untouched playing-strength holdout for this model.
Host rule engine labels and replay checks share rule implementation, not independent proof that those rules are correct.
Target is potential base liability if opponent takes a legal HU, excluding situational bonuses, opponent claim choice, changed-state continuations and future net score.
Simulated policy selection and state distribution may shift under a new player; aggregate calibration does not establish calibration in every state or stratum.
Low predicted HU bins overestimate; high-risk tail underestimates frequency and payment. Tail mass is small; retain all calibration and worse seeds.
New fresh development comparisons of complete games are required before any promotion; final formal untouched seeds and protocol still pending.
